name: data_whtml_builder
description: Data Tool - WHTML builder to insert elements from HTML and CSS strings on a page via the public-mcp headless surface. Accepts HTML markup and optional raw CSS rules, constructs WHTML, and inserts it into a parent element.

siteId.description: Webflow site ID. Use list_sites to discover site IDs.

pageId.description: Any valid page id that exists in the site

build_label.description: A label to identify this build action in the results.

component.description: The component id of the element to perform action on.

element.description: The element id of the element to perform action on.

prop.description: Optional text prop id. Set when the parent is an element inside a TextPropElement or RichTextPropElement of a component instance.

parent_element_id.description: The id of the parent element to insert WHTML into, you can find it from id field on element. e.g id:{component:123,element:456}.

creation_position.description: The position to insert the element. append/prepend insert as child of the parent element. before/after insert as sibling adjacent to the target element.

html.description: HTML markup string to insert. Must not contain <style> tags. CSS should be provided via the css parameter instead.

css.description: Optional CSS rules to apply. Must not contain <style> tags. Provide raw CSS rules only (e.g. '.my-class { color: red; }').

return_element_info.description: Whether to return full element info for the inserted element. Defaults to false.

scope_component_id.description: Optional component id. When set, the parent_element_id lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page tree — required to insert into a component definition.

actions.description: WHTML insertion actions executed sequentially. Each item inserts one HTML/CSS fragment at the requested position.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.
